item.title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee accused of planting hidden recording device in conference room
item.description: Federal prosecutors have charged Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national who worked on OpenAI's product team, with using an electronic device to intercept oral communications after the company discovered a hidden recording device in an executive conference room at its San Francisco office. item.title: Hot CPI inflation pushes stocks lower, raises Fed rate-hike bets
item.description: U.S. stocks fell and Treasury yields jumped Wednesday after the September consumer price index came in hotter than expected, prompting investors to raise bets on further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes.
